[{"tablename":"text.sql","select":"SELECT 
    origin, 
    dest,
    uniquecarrier,
    COUNT(*) AS flight_count
FROM iceberg.db_user001.fct_flights
WHERE origin in ('ORD','PHX','LAX','LAS','SFO','BOS')
GROUP BY origin, dest, uniquecarrier
ORDER BY flight_count DESC
LIMIT 25","columns":[{"name":"origin","type":"STRING","alias":"origin","isdim":true},{"name":"dest","type":"STRING","alias":"dest","isdim":true},{"name":"flight_count","type":"BIGINT","alias":"flight_count","isdim":false},{"name":"uniquecarrier","type":"STRING","isdim":true,"alias":"uniquecarrier"}]}]

[{"tablename":"text.sql","select":"SELECT 
    a.description AS airline_name,
    f.uniquecarrier,
    COUNT(*) AS flight_count
FROM iceberg.db_user001.fct_flights f
JOIN iceberg.db_user001.dim_airlines a ON f.uniquecarrier = a.code
GROUP BY a.description,f.uniquecarrier
ORDER BY flight_count DESC","columns":[{"name":"airline_name","type":"STRING","alias":"airline_name","isdim":true},{"name":"flight_count","type":"BIGINT","alias":"flight_count","isdim":false},{"name":"uniquecarrier","type":"STRING","isdim":true,"alias":"uniquecarrier"}]}]

[{"tablename":"text.sql","select":"SELECT 
    dayofweek,
    uniquecarrier,
    COUNT(*) AS total_flights,
    AVG(arrdelay) AS avg_arrival_delay
FROM iceberg.db_user001.fct_flights
WHERE cancelled = 0
GROUP BY dayofweek,uniquecarrier
ORDER BY dayofweek ASC","columns":[{"name":"dayofweek","type":"INT","alias":"dayofweek","isdim":false},{"name":"total_flights","type":"BIGINT","alias":"total_flights","isdim":false},{"name":"avg_arrival_delay","type":"DOUBLE","alias":"avg_arrival_delay","isdim":false},{"name":"uniquecarrier","type":"STRING","isdim":true,"alias":"uniquecarrier"}]}]

[{"tablename":"text.sql","select":"SELECT 
    month,
    dayofweek,
    uniquecarrier,
    (CAST(SUM(cancelled) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*)) * 100 AS cancellation_rate
FROM iceberg.db_user001.fct_flights
WHERE year IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY month, dayofweek,uniquecarrier
ORDER BY month, dayofweek,uniquecarrier","columns":[{"name":"month","type":"INT","alias":"month","isdim":false},{"name":"dayofweek","type":"INT","alias":"dayofweek","isdim":false},{"name":"cancellation_rate","type":"DOUBLE","alias":"cancellation_rate","isdim":false},{"name":"uniquecarrier","type":"STRING","isdim":true,"alias":"uniquecarrier"}]}]

[{"tablename":"text.sql","select":"SELECT 
    f.uniquecarrier,
    a.description AS airline_name,
    SUM(f.carrierdelay) AS carrier_delay,
    SUM(f.weatherdelay) AS weather_delay,
    SUM(f.nasdelay) AS nas_delay,
    SUM(f.securitydelay) AS security_delay,
    SUM(f.lateaircraftdelay) AS late_aircraft_delay
FROM iceberg.db_user001.fct_flights f
JOIN iceberg.db_user001.dim_airlines a ON f.uniquecarrier = a.code
WHERE f.cancelled = 0
GROUP BY a.description,f.uniquecarrier
ORDER BY (SUM(f.carrierdelay) + SUM(f.weatherdelay) + SUM(f.nasdelay) + SUM(f.securitydelay) + SUM(f.lateaircraftdelay)) DESC
LIMIT 10","columns":[{"name":"airline_name","type":"STRING","alias":"airline_name","isdim":true},{"name":"carrier_delay","type":"BIGINT","alias":"carrier_delay","isdim":false},{"name":"weather_delay","type":"BIGINT","alias":"weather_delay","isdim":false},{"name":"nas_delay","type":"BIGINT","alias":"nas_delay","isdim":false},{"name":"security_delay","type":"BIGINT","alias":"security_delay","isdim":false},{"name":"late_aircraft_delay","type":"BIGINT","alias":"late_aircraft_delay","isdim":false},{"name":"uniquecarrier","type":"STRING","isdim":true,"alias":"uniquecarrier"}]}]

[{"tablename":"text.sql","select":"SELECT 
   uniquecarrier,
        LPAD(CAST((deptime / 100) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || ':00' AS hour_window,
    AVG(f.taxiin) AS avg_taxi_in,
    AVG(f.taxiout) AS avg_taxi_out
FROM iceberg.db_user001.fct_flights f
WHERE f.deptime IS NOT NULL
AND f.deptime < 2500
AND f.taxiin < 300
GROUP BY 2,uniquecarrier
ORDER BY 1 ASC","columns":[{"name":"avg_taxi_in","type":"DOUBLE","alias":"avg_taxi_in","isdim":false},{"name":"avg_taxi_out","type":"DOUBLE","alias":"avg_taxi_out","isdim":false},{"name":"hour_window","type":"STRING","isdim":true,"alias":"hour_window"},{"name":"uniquecarrier","type":"STRING","isdim":true,"alias":"uniquecarrier"}]}]
